metadata.description: DarcStar Technologies Claude Code plugin marketplace — a public showcase of our automation and tooling craft.

plugins.name: plugin-forge
plugins.description: Generate a new plugin from a natural-language description: infers name, components, tools, and minimum-capable models, defaults to the current template version, and prompts for anything it can't confidently infer.

plugins.name: semver
plugins.description: Deterministic semver operations: validate, compare, bump, and next-version from Conventional Commits.

plugins.name: scaffold-upgrade
plugins.description: Check whether a plugin scaffolded from a template can be upgraded to the latest version of that template.

plugins.name: plugin-editor
plugins.description: Guided assistant that modifies an existing plugin from a natural-language request, then checks template lineage, updates its changelog and version, and flags a stale active install.

plugins.name: template-forge
plugins.description: Scaffold a new reference template under templates/ for this marketplace, from a natural-language description, guided prompts, or the components of an existing plugin.

plugins.name: edit-kit
plugins.description: Shared deterministic edit-flow scripts (changelog, versioning, structure check, repo verification, test scaffolding) that plugin-editor and template-editor resolve at run time; a provider plugin with no command of its own.

plugins.name: template-editor
plugins.description: Safely modify an existing reference template under templates/ — add a component, change a behavior, fix a bug, or remove a capability — via a plan-confirm-apply flow with template-appropriate housekeeping (structure check, changelog, version, repo verification) reused from edit-kit.

plugins.name: dep-doctor
plugins.description: Diagnose a target plugin's dependencies — CLI tools, libraries, MCP servers, and other plugins — and, with explicit confirmation, install or fix what is missing via a plan-confirm-apply flow.

plugins.name: scaffold-retarget
plugins.description: Upgrade or downgrade an already-scaffolded plugin to a different version of the reference template it was created from, via a plan-confirm-apply flow.
